{{Quote|4,000 credits &hellip; only 4000. You look like you could use a break, kid. Sold.|translated=1|Wioslea|<ref name="GG7" />}}
'''Wioslea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Vuvrian/Legends|Vuvrian]]. Like all Vuvrians, she had multiple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] located around her head, and two large tentacles coming off the top of her head.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Wioslea|Fifteen hundred is all I can offer you, human.|Luke Skywalker|Fifteen hundred? Look, this landspeeder's in great shape, even if it's not very pretty.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|We can accept no less than two thousand.|Wioslea|Your grip on reality is fragile, humans. It's the newer models that are in demand now, not these old ones. I shall probably have to sell it at a loss.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|But it's still not a fair price.|Wioslea|You touch a responsive chord in my&hellip; charitable nature, humans. Sixteen hundred.|attr=Wiosela negotiating the sale of Luke's landspeeder|src=<ref name="The Han Solo Solution">{{SWRadio|The Han Solo Solution}}</ref>}}
[[File:CZ-3_1.png|thumb|left|250px|Wioslea purchases Luke Skywalker's landspeeder]]
Wioslea was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Vuvrian/Legends|Vuvrian]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and worked as a salesperson at [[Spaceport Speeders/Legends|Spaceport Speeders]], a local [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] company that bought and sold [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and other vehicles.<ref name="GG7" /> First seen in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|Mos Eisley Cantina]] seated in an alcove with [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep]], [[Greedo]], and [[Tzizvvt]]; she bought [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]],<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> which he sold in order to finance the negotiated upfront fee for passage aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to persuade Wioslea into paying 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the speeder, much more than it was worth.<ref name="SWJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>

[[0 ABY/Legends|Seven months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Wioslea sold a landspeeder to [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].

==Personality and traits==
Wioslea did not speak about events from her past prior to her employment by [[Unut Poll]]. She hoped to someday relocate to another planet after paying off her debts; at one [[Time/Legends|time]], she owed 1,000 credits to an underling of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. As a result, she began spying for Jabba.<ref name="GG7" />

==Skills and abilities==
Wioslea was proficient in multiple [[Language/Legends|languages]]: [[Aqualish (language)/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Arconese/Legends|Arcona]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodian]], [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustan]], and [[Vregg]].<ref name="GG7" />

==Equipment==
Wioslea wore simple robes very similar to a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ANHaliengroupshot.jpg|thumb|right|280px|A behind-the-scenes photograph of Tatooine aliens, including Wioslea]]
Wioslea was played in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] by actor David Stone, who later played [[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|al4wfc|status/652915852250083331|Adrian Lacey|archivedate=20230603110053}}</ref><ref name="Oxford Mail">{{WebCite|url=https://www.oxfordmail.co.uk/news/17673550.wantage-comic-con-2019-feature-oscar-winner-ben-morris|text=Wantage Comic Con 2019 to feature Oscar winner Ben Morris|archivedate=20211207125112}}</ref><ref name="Autograph">{{Facebook|username=StarwarsAutographCollecting|url=StarwarsAutographCollecting/photos/david-stone-b-wing-pilot-autographlatest-addition-is-david-stone-mr-stone-was-no/1051814834852006|name=Star Wars Autograph Collecting|date=2015-10-22|quote=David Stone B wing pilot Autograph|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/cJVlx}}</ref> Wioslea was designed by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] himself.<ref name="OM">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref>

The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] says a "tall, slightly insectoid" male purchased Luke's landspeeder, but this individual is never named or described any further. It says he haggles with Luke and Obi-Wan but provides no details.

Wioslea was released as a [[Hasbro]] action figure in 2009.
